test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 10
subject: general
question:
In the question given below, a statement is followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. You have to consider the statement and decide which of the assumptions is implicit in the statement.

**Statement: **

The children start crying very soon.

**Assumption: **

I. They have high desire to get everything.

II. They can’t say what they need.

options.text: If only assumption I is implicit
If only assumption II is implicit
If neither I or II is implicit
If both I and II are implicit

solution:
**Assumption: **

I. They have high desire to get everything → False (children cry not only when they need something)

II. They can’t say what they need → False (children of age above 2 or 3 years can speak)

Hence, neither assumption I nor II is implicit.
